description: Independently find authoritative STP camera FOV/mount rules in repository research and public official docs. Own only simulation/scenarios/phobos_escape.json, simulation/src/scenario* and sensors/* if verified changes are supported. Current 90 degrees was a practice default, not validated. Match actual projection axes and stated convention, enforce intrinsic resolution/mount/exposure separation from debug zoom, cite exact source. Do not guess unavailable FOV. Coordinate with compact HUD: sensors/view owns only its caption/layout. No automation, mocks, extra docs/test projects, fixed system paths, new recipes, builds or commits.
notes: Sourced mount/aim corrections and FOV transparency are implemented and module-formatted, awaiting main checks. Exact official intrinsic FOV remains blocked: rules and STU4 camera table specify mounts and pan/tilt limits, not a mandatory lens angle; official generated API lists writable FOV: float without axis/full-vs-half convention or numeric limits. Starter UserAPI.py says Example for obtaining an image ... FOV = 60 deg, not a rule. Kept existing 90-degree vertical full angle as practice_unverified. Main should request the user official STP camera/capture spec or runtime configuration establishing the required angle, convention and allowable intrinsic range before replacing it or claiming optical parity.

comments.author: koalazub
comments.text: Official sources found: https://github.com/SimDynamX/STU4-Solution/wiki/1.-Vehicle-Specs-and-Model-Details#cameras gives top mount [1.27,0,0.9]m, bottom [1.675,0,-1.025]m; yaw [-89,89] both; pitch top [-50,0], bottom [0,50]. Euler321 passive body-to-camera, positive yaw left and pitch down, implying zero-angle forward +X/up +Z, NOT current +/-Z. API example FOV=60deg is not fixed normative rule; https://github.com/SimDynamX/SpaceTeamsPRO/wiki/Entity-Types#camera says capture properties supplied each capture, not camera entity parameters. Checking API FOV convention before numerical FOV change; will retain 90 practice if no authoritative angle axis. Camera main may need sensor aim API for bounded pan/tilt; I own sensors only and can expose typed functions if wanted.

comments.author: koalazub
comments.text: FOV research result: official generated API https://simdynamx.github.io/stp-python-api-docs/autoapi/spaceteams/#spaceteams.CaptureImageProperties.FOV only says FOV: float, writable. No full/half/axis/default/mandatory limit specified; 60deg in starter code is explicitly example. Will NOT claim or change 90deg to an official limit. Implement sourced mount locations, explicit zero-roll Euler321 yaw/pitch values bounded by documented ranges, plus actual H/V/diagonal metadata and visible practice/unverified FOV flag. Remain fixed body mounts at allowed zero-angle aim and fixed 512-square RGB8/EV10015/ambient0. No pan input added without main integration. Caveat official simconf bottom has 180deg roll while wiki specifies zero roll; using documented commanded yaw=pitch=0, not claiming initial-runtime-default parity.
